      , customers_src_10000.country AS customer__country

      , subq_4.__revenue_eur AS revenue_eur

      -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'orders'
      -- Metric Time Dimension 'order_date'
      -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
      SELECT
        customer_id AS customer
        , status AS order__status
        , 1 AS __orders_total
        , amount AS __revenue_eur
      FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."orders" orders_src_10000

WITH ctr_1_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'leads'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'created_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __leads
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."leads" leads_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'campaigns'
  SELECT
    channel
    , campaign_id AS campaign
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."campaigns" campaigns_src_10000
)

, sma_10004_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'bookings'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'booked_date'
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', booked_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __bookings
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."bookings" bookings_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_26.lead_to_booking_rate) AS lead_to_booking_rate
  , MAX(subq_35.leads) AS leads
  , MAX(subq_45.bookings) AS bookings
FROM (
  -- Combine Aggregated Outputs
  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
  SELECT
    CAST(MAX(subq_24.__bookings) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_9.__leads), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lead_to_booking_rate
  FROM (
    -- Constrain Output with WHERE
    -- Select: ['__leads']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    SELECT
      SUM(leads) AS __leads
    FROM (
      -- Join Standard Outputs
      -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
      SELECT
        rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
        , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
      FROM ctr_1_cte
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        rss_10006_cte
      ON
        ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
    ) subq_6
    WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
  ) subq_9
  CROSS JOIN (
    -- Find conversions for lead within the range of 30 day
    -- Select: ['__bookings']
    -- Select: ['__bookings']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    SELECT
      SUM(__bookings) AS __bookings
    FROM (
      -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
      SELECT DISTINCT
        FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.__leads) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS __leads
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign__channel) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS campaign__channel
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.metric_time__day) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS metric_time__day
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.lead) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS lead
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS campaign
        , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid AS mf_internal_uuid
        , subq_19.__bookings AS __bookings
      FROM (
        -- Constrain Output with WHERE
        -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
        SELECT
          metric_time__day
          , lead
          , campaign
          , campaign__channel
          , leads AS __leads
        FROM (
          -- Join Standard Outputs
          -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
          SELECT
            ctr_1_cte.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
            , ctr_1_cte.lead AS lead
            , ctr_1_cte.campaign AS campaign
            , rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
            , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
          FROM ctr_1_cte
          LEFT OUTER JOIN
            rss_10006_cte
          ON
            ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
        ) subq_14
        WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
      ) subq_16
      INNER JOIN (
        -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10004
        -- Add column with generated UUID
        SELECT
          metric_time__day
          , lead
          , __bookings
          , GEN_RANDOM_UUID() AS mf_internal_uuid
        FROM sma_10004_cte
      ) subq_19
      ON
        (
          subq_16.lead = subq_19.lead
        ) AND (
          (
            subq_16.metric_time__day <= subq_19.metric_time__day
          ) AND (
            subq_16.metric_time__day > subq_19.metric_time__day - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => 30)
          )
        )
    ) subq_20
  ) subq_24
) subq_26

  -- Select: ['__leads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions

  FROM (
    -- Join Standard Outputs
    -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
    SELECT

      , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
    FROM ctr_1_cte
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      rss_10006_cte
    ON

    -- Select: ['__bookings']

  -- Select: ['__bookings']

          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day

        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC

-- Combine Aggregated Outputs
-- Compute Metrics via Expressions
-- Order By [] Limit 200
-- Write to DataTable
WITH ctr_1_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'leads'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'created_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __leads
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."leads" leads_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'campaigns'
  SELECT
    channel
    , campaign_id AS campaign
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."campaigns" campaigns_src_10000
)

SELECT
  CAST(MAX(subq_24.__bookings) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_9.__leads), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lead_to_booking_rate
FROM (
  -- Constrain Output with WHERE
  -- Select: ['__leads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(leads) AS __leads
  FROM (
    -- Join Standard Outputs
    -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
    SELECT
      rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
      , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
    FROM ctr_1_cte
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      rss_10006_cte
    ON
      ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
  ) subq_6
  WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
) subq_9
CROSS JOIN (
  -- Find conversions for lead within the range of 30 day
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(__bookings) AS __bookings
  FROM (
    -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
    SELECT DISTINCT
      FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.__leads) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS __leads
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign__channel) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign__channel
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.metric_time__day) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS metric_time__day
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.lead) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS lead
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign
      , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid AS mf_internal_uuid
      , subq_19.__bookings AS __bookings
    FROM (
      -- Constrain Output with WHERE
      -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
      SELECT
        metric_time__day
        , lead
        , campaign
        , campaign__channel
        , leads AS __leads
      FROM (
        -- Join Standard Outputs
        -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
        SELECT
          ctr_1_cte.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
          , ctr_1_cte.lead AS lead
          , ctr_1_cte.campaign AS campaign
          , rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
          , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
        FROM ctr_1_cte
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10006_cte
        ON
          ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
      ) subq_14
      WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
    ) subq_16
    INNER JOIN (
      -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'bookings'
      -- Metric Time Dimension 'booked_date'
      -- Add column with generated UUID
      SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', booked_date) AS metric_time__day
        , lead_id AS lead
        , 1 AS __bookings
        , GEN_RANDOM_UUID() AS mf_internal_uuid
      FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."bookings" bookings_src_10000
    ) subq_19
    ON
      (
        subq_16.lead = subq_19.lead
      ) AND (
        (
          subq_16.metric_time__day <= subq_19.metric_time__day
        ) AND (
          subq_16.metric_time__day > subq_19.metric_time__day - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => 30)
        )
      )
  ) subq_20
) subq_24
LIMIT 200

-- Order By [] Limit 200
-- Write to DataTable
SELECT
  metric_time__month
  , customers_to_date
FROM (
  -- Window Function for Metric Re-aggregation
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , LAST_VALUE(customers_to_date) OVER (
      PARTITION BY metric_time__month
      ORDER BY metric_time__day
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS customers_to_date
  FROM (
    -- Constrain Output with WHERE
    -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
    -- Select: ['__signups', 'metric_time__month', 'metric_time__day']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
    -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
    SELECT
      metric_time__day
      , metric_time__month
      , SUM(signups) AS customers_to_date
    FROM (
      -- Join Self Over Time Range
      -- Select: ['__signups', 'customer__country', 'metric_time__month', 'metric_time__day']
      SELECT
        subq_6.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
        , subq_6.metric_time__month AS metric_time__month
        , subq_5.customer__country AS customer__country
        , subq_5.__signups AS signups
      FROM (
        -- Read From Time Spine '"time_spine"'
        SELECT
          date_day AS metric_time__day

FROM orders_subset o

    SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_ts
    FROM silver.orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
),
ordered AS (

           LAG(order_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts) AS prev_ts
    FROM sep_orders
),

    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_ts - prev_ts)) / 3600.0 AS gap_hours
    FROM ordered
    WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gap_hours) AS median_gap_hours
FROM gaps;

FROM range_orders;

WITH sept_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, order_ts
  FROM silver.orders
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
),
qualified_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM sept_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT so.customer_id,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (so.order_ts - LAG(so.order_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY so.customer_id ORDER BY so.order_ts)))/3600.0 AS gap_hours
  FROM sept_orders so
  JOIN qualified_customers qc USING (customer_id)
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gap_hours) AS median_gap_hours,
       COUNT(*) AS gap_count
FROM gaps
WHERE gap_hours IS NOT NULL;

WITH sept_orders AS (
    SELECT customer_id, order_ts
    FROM silver.orders
    WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+00'
      AND order_ts <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
),
gapped AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        order_ts,
        LAG(order_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts) AS prev_ts
    FROM sept_orders
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_ts - prev_ts)) / 3600.0 AS gap_hours
    FROM gapped
    WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gap_hours) AS median_gap_hours
FROM gaps;

  from silver.orders
  where order_date between date '2026-08-17' and date '2026-10-02'

-- Select: ['__revenue_eur', '__customers_distinct', 'customer__country']
-- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
-- Compute Metrics via Expressions
-- Order By [] Limit 200
-- Write to DataTable
SELECT
  customer__country
  , SUM(revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  , COUNT(DISTINCT customers_distinct) AS customers_distinct
FROM (
  -- Join Standard Outputs
  -- Select: ['__revenue_eur', '__customers_distinct', 'customer__country', 'order__status']
  SELECT
    subq_2.order__status AS order__status
    , customers_src_10000.country AS customer__country
    , subq_2.__revenue_eur AS revenue_eur
    , subq_2.__customers_distinct AS customers_distinct
  FROM (
    -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'orders'
    -- Metric Time Dimension 'order_date'
    -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
    SELECT
      customer_id AS customer
      , status AS order__status
      , amount AS __revenue_eur
      , customer_id AS __customers_distinct
    FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."orders" orders_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', order_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  ) subq_2
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "dbt_dev"."silver"."customers" customers_src_10000
  ON
    subq_2.customer = customers_src_10000.customer_id
) subq_7
WHERE order__status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY
  customer__country
LIMIT 200

  (SELECT SUM(revenue_eur) FROM gold.daily_sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03') AS total_revenue_eur,
  (SELECT SUM(site_sessions) FROM gold.customer_engagement_daily WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03') AS total_site_sessions,
  (SELECT SUM(revenue_eur) FROM gold.daily_sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03')
  / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(site_sessions) FROM gold.customer_engagement_daily WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'), 0) AS revenue_per_site_session_eur;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM silver.customers
  WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT count(*) FROM cohort) AS customers_signed_up_aug_2026,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT o.customer_id)
     FROM silver.orders o
     JOIN cohort c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_date <= DATE '2026-10-10'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled') AS bought_by_2026_10_10,
  round(
    100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT o.customer_id)
               FROM silver.orders o
               JOIN cohort c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
              WHERE o.order_date <= DATE '2026-10-10'
                AND o.status <> 'cancelled')
    / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cohort), 0), 2) AS share_of_cohort_percent;
